nse_pagination_explanation: NSE's /api/corporate-announcements endpoint is NOT paginated when queried with symbol + from_date + to_date; it returns the complete JSON array of all corporate announcements filed in that window in a single HTTP response.
our_pipeline_cap_explanation: Our pipeline (fetch_announcements.py -> select_representative_nse_rows) intentionally filters out duplicate XBRL .xml attachments, deduplicates by PDF URL, and caps LLM classification at max_items=6 per ticker (keeping the 2 newest filings + highest-priority material filings like Outcome of Board Meeting, Appointment/Cessation, Press Release, Dividend/Ratings while dropping repetitive 'Loss of Share Certificates' and daily ESOP allotment noise).
